name: Rice and Turnip Minestrone
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 4 cups chicken, beef, or vegetable stock, brought to a boil

steps: Arrange the turnip slices on a rack over a cookie sheet. Sprinkle with salt, cover them with a dish, and let them stand for about 2 hours until the water has run out of them.
Put the slices in a frying pan, and fry them slightly in butter until softened.
Add the gravy and tomatoes. Cook for a few minutes, then pour it into the boiling stock.
